component.name: SCAP Security
component.summary: OpenSCAP scanning, remediation and tailoring for this host

description.p: cockpit-scap runs OpenSCAP compliance scans on the host Cockpit runs on and shows the results in Cockpit.

ul.li: Host Scan: choose SCAP content, a profile and an optional tailoring policy, run the scan, and see the score and failing rules by severity
Download the HTML report, results XML and ARF of a scan
Remediation Builder: download a Bash script or Ansible playbook for selected failing rules, or apply the Bash fixes on the host
Scan History: completed scans are kept in the user's home directory, with the score change from the previous scan of the same profile
Policy Tailoring: enable or disable rules, change variable values, and save, upload or download XCCDF tailoring files
SCAP Content: list installed SCAP datastreams and upload your own
